queries.sql: SELECT SUM(IFNULL(dp.total_penjualan,0)) AS total_penjualan, SUM(IFNULL(pb.total_bayar,0)) AS total_dibayar, SUM(IFNULL(dp.total_penjualan,0) - IFNULL(pb.total_bayar,0)) AS total_piutang FROM `pesanan` LEFT JOIN ( SELECT idpesanan, SUM(subtotal) AS total_penjualan FROM detail_pesanan GROUP BY idpesanan ) dp ON dp.idpesanan = pesanan.idpesanan LEFT JOIN ( SELECT idpesanan, SUM(jumlahbayar) AS total_bayar FROM pembayaran WHERE statuspembayaran='valid' GROUP BY idpesanan ) pb ON pb.idpesanan = pesanan.idpesanan
